details.description: GLM-5.1 is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) open-weight Mixture-of-Experts flagship model for agentic engineering, released April 7, 2026, per Z.ai's release notes. It has 754 billion parameters, per its Hugging Face model card, and is built to sustain performance over long-horizon tasks across hundreds of iteration rounds, including autonomous runs of up to about 8 hours, per Z.ai's documentation. It supports thinking modes, function calling, structured JSON output, and MCP tool integration, with a 200K-token context window. As of September 2026, it has been superseded as Z.ai's flagship first by GLM-5.2 (released June 2026) and then by GLM-5.3 (released August 2026), though it remains an active, available model.
advantages: Scores 58.4 on SWE-Bench Pro, which Z.ai says outperforms GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro on that benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 95.3 on AIME 2026 and 86.2 on GPQA-Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 68.7 on CyberGym and 68.0 on BrowseComp, per its Hugging Face model card.
Designed for long-horizon autonomous work sustained across hundreds of iteration rounds, including runs of up to about 8 hours, per Z.ai's documentation.
Supports MCP tool integration, function calling, context caching, and structured JSON output, per Z.ai's documentation.
disadvantages: Superseded as Z.ai's flagship model by GLM-5.2 (released June 16, 2026) and then by GLM-5.3 (released August 18, 2026), per Z.ai's release notes, though GLM-5.1 remains an active, available model.
Scores lower than GLM-5.2 on every benchmark Z.ai lists for both models, including SWE-bench Pro (58.4 vs. 62.1) and AIME 2026 (95.3 vs. 99.2), per Z.ai's GLM-5.2 model card.
use_cases: Long-horizon autonomous agentic coding and engineering optimization
Multi-file repository generation and terminal-based operations
Front-end development and office productivity tasks

sources.title: New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT

notes: Z.ai's docs.z.ai guide states max output tokens as 128K and context window as 200K, matching the catalog's facts (202,800 input / 131,072 output) closely; the model's Hugging Face config.json confirms max_position_embeddings of 202,752. Release date (April 7, 2026) is from Z.ai's release-notes page; the Hugging Face model card gives no explicit launch date, only an arXiv technical-report id (2602.xxxxx, a February 2026 preprint), which is not used as the release date.
